title: Volvo Car Canada release (Cision) - Volvo Cars to open access to more than 17,800 NACS charging points through Tesla Supercharger network
notes: Volvo Canada release: owners of fully electric Volvo cars can order a NACS adapter (CA$310) from Nov 18, 2024; included with new 2025 EX90/EX40/EC40; EX30 adapter to be announced later.
